wages.text: Krell says businesses should pay living wages so Californians can afford to live in the state.
wages.quote: Maggy believes that we should help local businesses prosper and in turn, they should pay living wages so that Californians can afford to live here.

sentencing.text: Attempted to pass harsher penalties for soliciting sex from 16- and 17-year-olds, despite opposition from Democratic leaders.
sentencing.quote: She angered her progressive colleagues when she publicly defied Democratic leaders in attempting to pass harsher penalties for soliciting sex from 16- and 17-year-olds.
